//region-note: The Supabase DB is in Tokyo (ap-northeast-1) but functions run in the default iad1 (US East), so dashboard DB queries round-trip US<->Tokyo. The fix is to set the function region to Tokyo (hnd1), but a `regions` pin here is NOT allowed on the Hobby plan and FAILS the build (froze prod at cb3c6a9 on 2026-09-18). To move the region: set it in the Vercel dashboard (Settings -> Functions -> Region) on Hobby, or upgrade to Pro and re-add `"regions": ["hnd1"]` here.
